description: Adaptive scientific vocabulary for synchrotron, X-ray imaging, holography, ptychography, tomography, AI/ML, scientific computing and research projects.

synchrotron_beamline.label: Synchrotron, accelerator and beamline
synchrotron_beamline.description: Synchrotron radiation, storage rings, insertion devices, beamline operation and beam diagnostics.

xray_optics_microscopy.label: X-ray optics and microscopy
xray_optics_microscopy.description: Refractive, reflective and diffractive X-ray optics, focusing and scanning microscopy.

holography_phase_coherence.label: Holography, phase contrast and coherence
holography_phase_coherence.description: Near- and far-field holography, propagation, phase retrieval and coherent imaging.

ptychography_cdi.label: Ptychography and coherent diffraction imaging
ptychography_cdi.description: Ptychographic acquisition, reconstruction engines, CDI and multi-slice methods.

tomography_inverse.label: Tomography and inverse problems
tomography_inverse.description: CT geometries, reconstruction algorithms, regularization and inverse-problem methods.

spectroscopy_scanning_materials.label: Scanning modalities, spectroscopy and materials
spectroscopy_scanning_materials.description: XRF, XBIC, XEOL, diffraction microscopy, spectroscopy and materials characterization.

detectors_acquisition.label: Detectors, acquisition and calibration
detectors_acquisition.description: Area detectors, scintillators, acquisition settings, calibration and corrections.

ai_ml_image_processing.label: AI, machine learning and image processing
ai_ml_image_processing.description: Machine learning, deep learning, computer vision and scientific image analysis.

software_hpc.label: Scientific software, programming and HPC
software_hpc.description: Scientific Python, C++, CUDA, clusters, reconstruction software and visualization tools.

simulation_optimization.label: Simulation, numerical methods and optimization
simulation_optimization.description: Wave propagation, Monte Carlo, numerical solvers, optimization and uncertainty.

experimental_materials.label: Experimental methods and materials science
experimental_materials.description: Sample environments, deposition, microscopy, photovoltaics and materials experiments.

writing_projects.label: Scientific writing, proposals and EU projects
writing_projects.description: Scientific papers, proposals, work packages, deliverables and project strategy.
